Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
The on-line DCI tournament rules for V:TES are incomplete.
The printed version I received in the mail this week includes the
complete set of rules.

Added section:

-----
737. Rules for V:TES Rochester Draft Tournaments
This rule works in conjunction with Section 77 and 78 of the Universal
Tournament Rules.

Players open their first booster packs when the pod judge instructs them
to do so. After counting the cards face-down to make sure the pack is
correct, players then move all vampire (crypt) cards to the top of the
pack face-down. If players do not have the appropriate number of cards in
a pack, they must immediately notify the head judge, who will replace the
pack.

Players then place their opened packs face-down on the table in front of
them. At a signal from the pod judge, players place the top two cards from
their booster pack [sic] face-up on the table. The pod judge then has
players draft according to section 77 and 78 of the Universal Tournament
Rules until the packs are completely drafted.
-----
